# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project

"Baby Buddy" is a single-module Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3) generated by Google AI Studio. It is a mobile client for a self-hosted [Baby Buddy](https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy) server (feeding, sleep, diaper tracking) plus several local-only features (dashboard widgets, home-screen widgets, nursing timer).

## Build & test

The Gradle wrapper (Gradle 9.8.1; AGP 9.4, Kotlin 2.4, compileSdk 37, targetSdk 36) is checked in:

```bash
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug                 # build debug APK
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest             # JVM/Robolectric unit tests (app/src/test)
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.example.ExampleRobolectricTest"            # one class
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.example.ExampleRobolectricTest.*timer*"   # filter by name
./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest     # instrumented tests (needs device/emulator)
```

Releases: `.github/workflows/release.yml` builds a signed `assembleRelease` APK and attaches it to a GitHub release when a `vX.Y.Z` tag is pushed (or run by hand with a version). `versionCode`/`versionName` are literals in `app/build.gradle.kts` (F-Droid reads them there; versionCode = X*10000+Y*100+Z): bump both, commit, then tag; the workflow fails if the tag doesn't match. It signs with the existing `release` signing config via `KEYSTORE_PATH`/`STORE_PASSWORD`/`KEY_PASSWORD`, from the repo secrets `KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `STORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_PASSWORD` (key alias `upload`).

Store listing (F-Droid / IzzyOnDroid): `fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/` holds the title, short (≤80 chars) and full description, `changelogs/<versionCode>.txt` (add one per release) and `images/phoneScreenshots/` (also used by the README; demo data only). The F-Droid build recipe draft is `docs/fdroid/dev.liorbass.babybuddy.yml`. Obtainium: the README badge links to an `obtainium://app/` import; `docs/obtainium/dev.liorbass.babybuddy.json` is the entry for Obtainium's app directory (a PR to `ImranR98/apps.obtainium.imranr.dev` as `public/data/apps/simple/dev.liorbass.babybuddy.json`, accepted once the repo has 35+ stars and is 4+ months old, i.e. from 2027-02-13). Its icon is `fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/icon.png`, rendered from the adaptive launcher icon (the `mipmap-*/ic_launcher.webp` files are still the stock placeholder).

Pre-commit (`.pre-commit-config.yaml`, pre-commit.com; `pre-commit install` per clone, also run in CI on every push by `.github/workflows/checks.yml`; `build.yml` builds the debug APK and runs unit tests, skipping docs-only pushes): pre-commit-hooks hygiene, gitleaks (extra rules in `.gitleaks.toml`: Baby Buddy API keys, private IPs), actionlint, ktlint via `pretty-format-kotlin` (rules in `.editorconfig`, IntelliJ style tuned to this code: no trailing commas, comments after parameters allowed; `app/build.gradle.kts` excluded), blocks on keystores/`.env`/`local.properties`/APKs/data exports, and `tools/hooks/check-personal-words.sh` against the gitignored `tools/hooks/blocklist.local`. Never put real names, the server address or tokens in code, docs or screenshots; demo data uses "Sam"/"Alex".

Formatting/lint: ktlint through pre-commit (see above); `kotlin.code.style=official` in Gradle.

Build notes:
- The debug build type signs with `${rootDir}/debug.keystore` (gitignored, not present locally). Per the README, remove `signingConfig = signingConfigs.getByName("debugConfig")` from `app/build.gradle.kts` locally if the build fails on signing — but the file comments say not to modify the signing configs for AI Studio, so don't commit that change.
- No Firebase or other Google services (removed: they were unused). Dependabot (`.github/dependabot.yml`) opens weekly grouped PRs for Gradle and Actions; bump pre-commit hooks with `pre-commit autoupdate`.
- Dependency versions live in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Unused libraries are removed (not commented out), so Dependabot doesn't keep updating them; there is no KSP, Room or Firebase.
- Robolectric tests run with `@Config(sdk = [36])`. Robolectric 4.17 needs the `--add-exports`/`--add-opens` JVM flags set in `testOptions` (`app/build.gradle.kts`).

## Architecture

Package root is `com.example` (applicationId `dev.liorbass.babybuddy`; app name "Baby Buddy Companion").

**State flow:** `BabyBuddyRepository` (singleton via `BabyBuddyRepository.instance`) is the single source of truth, holding all app state as `MutableStateFlow`s. `MainViewModel` re-exposes those flows, owns UI-only state (current screen, toast, modal visibility), and wraps repository mutations with user-facing toasts. Composables receive the ViewModel/state and callbacks from `MainActivity`.

**Persistence.** `BabyBuddyApplication` calls `repository.attach(context)` on every process start. Saved state: the server login in SharedPreferences `baby_buddy` (API token encrypted with an Android Keystore key via `SecretCipher`), the running nursing timer (same prefs), and in `filesDir/offline/` (`OfflineStore`, Moshi JSON) the unsent-write queue and a cache of today's entries. These are excluded from backups. Without a saved login the app shows only the login screen (`needsLogin` in `BabyBuddyApp`), which offers demo mode ("Try the demo" link and button, `repository.enterDemoMode`) and a "What is Baby Buddy?" explainer linking to the server repo. Demo mode shows all of Settings too; its data is `generateDemoHistory` (`data/repository/DemoData.kt`: 90 seeded, simulated days up to now with growth, so every screen and the rhythm models have data; covered by a test), and entering it sets the baby's sex, turns reminders on (if all were off) and the Models tab, and fits and saves rhythm models in the background. `disconnect` clears saved models. Settings → About shows `BuildConfig.GIT_DESCRIBE` / `BUILD_DATE` and links to this app's GitHub repo and the Baby Buddy server repo; they're set in `app/build.gradle.kts` (git describe; the UTC date, from `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` when set, date only so the configuration cache lasts the day).

**Navigation** is not Navigation-Compose: it's a `ScreenDestination` enum in `MainViewModel` and a `when (currentScreen)` switch in `BabyBuddyApp` in `MainActivity.kt`. Adding a screen means adding an enum value and a branch there. Back handling returns to `TODAY_DASHBOARD`.

**Server integration** (`data/api/BabyBuddyApi.kt`): Retrofit + Moshi (reflection `KotlinJsonAdapterFactory`) against the Baby Buddy REST API (`api/children/`, `api/feedings/`, `api/sleep/`, `api/changes/`), with `Authorization: Token <token>` passed per call. "Allow self-signed certificates" is trust on first use, never trust-all (Play rejects that): `createService` installs `PinningTrustManager`, which trusts what the system trusts plus the one certificate whose SHA-256 is pinned (`pinnedCertSha256`, prefs `pinned_cert_sha256`). An unknown certificate fails with `UntrustedCertificateException` (look it up with `findInChain`: OkHttp may leave it suppressed under an IPv6 connect error), and `MainViewModel` shows its fingerprint in a Trust dialog (`CertificatePrompt`) and reconnects with that pin. Logins saved before pinning adopt the server's current certificate on start. Tested in `CertificatePinningTest` (MockWebServer). It also adds `CF-Access-Client-Id`/`CF-Access-Client-Secret` headers when a Cloudflare Access service token is set on the login screen (secret stored encrypted like the API token). `repository.testConnection` fetches children and recent events and maps DTOs into UI models (`data/model/Models.kt`). `syncToday` fetches only entries since local midnight (UTC `start_min`/`date_min` filters) and merges them with local entries that still have queued writes (`mergeWithPending`). Local events carry `serverId`/`timeMillis`. All writes (create/update/delete for feedings, changes, tummy-times, pumping) are `QueuedWrite` data records sent in order by `flushPendingWrites` through the generic `createRecord`/`updateRecord`/`deleteRecord` endpoints: network/5xx errors retry with backoff, 4xx are dropped with a `syncErrors` toast (except non-JSON 4xx, i.e. a proxy's error page, retried up to `PROXY_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` times first), a retried create first looks for an existing record (lost response), and a successful create fills in the server id of later queued edits. Diaper amount (Light/Medium/Heavy, `DIAPER_AMOUNTS`), rash, cream and consistency have no server fields and round-trip through one "Amount: … | Rash | Cream: … | Consistency: …" notes line. Sleep (`api/sleep/`) has its own screen (`ui/screens/SleepScreen.kt`, `ScreenDestination.SLEEP`, a Today quick action): a timer kept on the phone (`repository.sleepTimer`, saved in prefs) that creates the entry when stopped, or a past sleep entered by start/end; Today syncs sleeps that ended today (`end_min`). Trends (`loadTrends`) and History (`loadHistory`, a week of feeds/diapers/pumping/tummy time) query the server directly. History opens as a list (`ui/screens/HistoryList.kt`, filtered by `HistoryFilter`; Today's summary tiles open it pre-filtered via `viewModel.openHistory`) with the week calendar behind a toggle. `repository.lastBreastfeed` is the latest breastfeed (today's, else fetched from the server) and drives the "last side" shown on Today, the Left/Right controls and the timer widget (`FeedingEvent.lastSide`). `repository.lastFeed` is the latest feed of either kind (bottles count as feeds: Today's Last feed card, `lastFeedMillis` for reminders); while a feed runs, `previousFeedMillis` (the feed before it) is shown under the Left/Right controls as "… since the previous feed".

**Settings** (`ConnectBackendScreen.kt`, `ScreenDestination.CONNECT_SERVER`): logged out it is just the login form; logged in it is a list of expandable categories (`SettingsSection`): Server connection, You, Appearance, Notifications. Put new settings in the fitting category.

Trends (`TrendsScreen.kt`) has feeding, sleep and diaper rhythm charts (one row per day across 24h; sleep and diaper ones share `DayTimeChart`), built from `DayStats` marks in `repository.loadTrends`. An optional Models tab (Settings → Appearance, `repository.modelsTab`; `ui/screens/RhythmModelsTab.kt`, `MainViewModel.trainModels`) fits one model per rhythm on the phone (`data/ml/`, pure Kotlin, no libraries): `RhythmFeatures` turns 30–90 days of entries (`repository.loadRhythmEvents`) into datasets for feed gap, diaper gap, sleep length and awake window (inputs: time of day, age, previous intervals, time since the other events, 24h totals); `AutoMl` scores ridge regression, boosted trees, a small neural net, nearest neighbours and recent time-of-day medians (`TimeOfDayMedian`, given the input columns via `candidates(features)`) over a grid of settings with rolling-origin validation against a median baseline and the app's default estimate (a `reference` candidate, scored but never picked: the reminder's fixed interval, else the average interval), refits the winner and gives permutation importance. Training covers 30–180 days or a custom date range (fetches page through results, `allPages`). Any leaderboard entry can be saved per rhythm (`viewModel.saveModel`; "Save this version" replaces the saved one, Reset / Reset all go back to the default): `SavedRhythmModel` (the model encoded as numbers, `Regressor.encode`/`decode`) in prefs `rhythm_models`, `repository.usedModels`. `repository.updatePredictions` (on every new feed/change/sleep, and before reminders fire) predicts with them from today's entries plus the previous day's from the server (`predictRhythms`; a model saved for a different number of inputs is ignored) into `rhythmPredictions`; `modelDue(target, anchor)` is used by `Reminders` instead of the fixed interval, and `modelNextTimes` by Today's Next card and the summary widget's "Next:" line. Saved models keep up to 49 validation errors (`Score.residuals`); once a predicted time passes, `RhythmPrediction.expectedMillis` re-estimates it from the errors that ran longer (`modelNextTimes` ticks every minute), while reminders keep the original `dueMillis` (a moving time would never fire).

**Dashboard widgets** (in-app cards) are driven by `DashboardWidgetType` / `DashboardWidgetConfig` in the repository; cards render in `ui/components/DashboardWidgetCards.kt` and are added via `AddWidgetModal.kt`. Customize Today also picks which Today summary tiles show (`TodayTile`, incl. a Wake window tile; prefs `hidden_summary_tiles`, saved as what's off so new tiles show; tracked items still apply).

**Home-screen widgets** (`widget/`): three `AppWidgetProvider`s (QuickLog, Timer, Summary) using RemoteViews layouts in `res/layout/widget_*.xml`. Button taps go either to `WidgetActionReceiver` (broadcast actions that mutate `BabyBuddyRepository.instance` directly, then call `WidgetManagerHelper.updateAllWidgets`) or launch `MainActivity` with the `EXTRA_NAVIGATE_TO` extra, which `handleWidgetNavigation` maps to a `ScreenDestination`. New receivers/providers must be registered in `AndroidManifest.xml`.

**Nursing timer** has no save step: `repository.tapSide(side)` starts a feed (creating its feeding record immediately), switches side, or pauses the running side, and every tap plus each elapsed minute updates that record through the write queue (consecutive queued updates of one entry are coalesced). A feed paused for 30 minutes (`SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS`) ends on its own; `endFeed()` ends it now. `setSideSeconds` lets the user correct one side's time mid-feed (the Edit buttons under the side buttons); it bumps `LiveTimerState.editCount` so widgets and the notification redraw their clocks. `setFeedStart` (moves the start; the difference goes to the first side) backs the Started field (there is no Finish field; `lastActiveMillis` only arrives from shared timers). The timer ticks in the repository (`startTimerTicker`, wall-clock based) and its state is persisted; the timer widget uses a self-ticking `Chronometer`. Widgets refresh automatically from `repository.widgetState` (collected in `BabyBuddyApplication`). Shared Left/Right UI: `ui/components/BreastSideControls.kt`.

Each tracked item has its own warm accent (`ui/theme/ItemColors.kt`: `tint`/`soft` per `TrackedItem`, day and night), used for Today tiles and shortcuts, Log entries, History list and calendar, Trends charts, widget previews and the diaper type buttons; use it for new item UI. The theme is all warm: primary terracotta, secondary olive ("all good" states: synced, added, saved), tertiary plum; no blues or greens. Home-screen widgets mirror these in `res/values/colors.xml` (`bb_diaper`, `bb_sleep`, …).

UI screens are large single-file composables in `ui/screens/` (e.g. `TodayDashboardScreen.kt` is ~2k lines); shared pieces are in `ui/components/CommonComponents.kt`, theme in `ui/theme/`.

**Caregiver and generated note text.** Server notes carry "Caregiver: Name" (and on breastfeeds "Left: … | Right: … | Sides: …"). Mapping strips these into fields (`caregiver`, `sides`, durations) so `notes` holds only what people wrote; `composeFeedingNotes` / `withCaregiver` rebuild them when sending. New entries get this phone's name from Settings → You.

**Night mode, refresh, notification.** `AppTheme.isNight` (ui/theme/Color.kt) flips every color getter to a dim warm palette; `MainActivity` sets it from Settings → Appearance (`ThemeMode`: by time of day 20:00–07:00 (default), same as phone, light, dark; `repository.themeMode`) and refreshes (`viewModel.refresh()`) on resume and every 3 minutes. `widget/FeedNotification.kt` shows lock-screen Left/Right/End controls while a feed runs (toggle in Settings); `BabyBuddyApplication` keeps it in sync with the timer. Quick logs return the new entry's id so toasts can offer Undo (`UiNotification.undo`).

In-app dashboard cards are Last feed and Last diaper (on by default, shown side by side at the top of Today with time since; `repository.lastDiaper` = today's latest, else the server's), Wake windows (on by default, below them: time awake since `lastSleepEndMillis` with progress to the model's next sleep or the awake reminder, and today's windows from `completedWakeWindows` in `data/model/WakeWindows.kt`; its parts (`WakeWindowPart`: Awake for, Nap due, today's stats, each window) are chosen under the card in Customize Today, prefs `hidden_wake_window_parts`; the Next card leaves out "Awake for" / "Next sleep" while the card shows them), Tummy time, Temperature, Notes and Growth (`DashboardWidgetType`; which are on is saved in prefs `dashboard_widgets`, with `dashboard_widgets_known` so newly added types keep their default); temperature and notes sync with `api/temperature/` and `api/notes/`. Growth (`TrackedItem.GROWTH`, not a Today quick action) is weight, length and head circumference (`GrowthKind`: server endpoints `weight`, `height`, `head-circumference`; `GrowthEvent`, date-only on the server so `dateMillis` is local noon; `repository.growth` = all of them, fetched with `getGrowth`). Logged together from the Log screen or the Growth card (`GrowthForm`/`GrowthDialog`), one server entry per filled-in field. Each measurement is edited or deleted (`EditGrowthDialog`, `repository.updateGrowth`) from History (`HistoryFilter.GROWTH` lists every measurement, not the week's; All shows the week's) or by tapping its point on the Trends chart. Trends has a Growth section (by age, independent of the 7/30-day range) charting them against the WHO Child Growth Standards: `data/model/WhoGrowthStandards.kt` is generated from the WHO's official expanded LMS tables (who.int, weekly samples, birth to 2 years; regenerate, don't hand-edit) and gives value/z-score/percentile (`growthPercentile`). The WHO charts differ by sex, which Baby Buddy doesn't store: `repository.babySex` (prefs `baby_sex`, Settings → You or the Trends prompt). Diaper consistency and color are optional (empty = not recorded); the Log screen and the Diaper quick action share one form (`DiaperForm` in `DiaperLogScreen.kt`), and the History list shows them with amount, rash/cream and the full note under each entry.

The Log screen (`QuickLogModal.kt`) is one list of entries (Breastfeeding, Bottle, Diaper, Sleep (`SleepPanel` from `SleepScreen.kt`), Pumping, Bath, Growth; hidden tracked items left out); tapping one expands its form in place. The forms (`BottleForm`, `PumpingForm` in `EntryDialogs.kt`) are shared with the dialogs; the diaper entry is `DiaperForm`, the same as the Diaper quick action.

Today's shortcut row (`QuickAction`: Feeding, Diaper, Pump, Tummy time, Sleep) is user-chosen and ordered via the pencil button (`QuickActionsEditorDialog`); saved in prefs as `quick_actions`.

Picked times go through `TimeField`/`TimePickDialog` (`ui/components/EntryDialogs.kt`), which hold one moment (millis). Every time/duration entry offers scroll wheels or typing (`ui/components/WheelPickers.kt`: `ClockTimeEntry`, `DurationWheels`, `InputModeToggle`; the choice is `TimeFormat.useWheel`, typing by default, saved by the repository). `ClockTimeEntry`'s wheels are date | hour : minute as one continuous time: minutes going round carry into the hour, the hour into the date, and the date wheel runs across months and years (two years back, a week ahead). A typed time is the latest past moment (`TimeFormat.latestAt`), or with `keepDay` (editing an entry) stays on the picked day. Duration seconds/minutes wheels carry into the first wheel. Forms show times and durations as tap-to-edit rows (`TimeField`, `SecondsField` mm:ss, `DurationField` hh:mm) that open one picker in a dialog, never inline wheels. Durations: `DurationInput` (mm:ss), `DurationField`/`DurationPickDialog` (hh:mm, used for reminder intervals). The feed notification uses the system chronometer for the total and is only re-posted on changes (start, pause, side switch, edits), never every second.

Times use `TimeFormat.clock` (`data/model/TimeFormat.kt`): 24h by default, 12h via Settings → Appearance (`repository.setUse24h`, which also reformats every stored `timeFormatted`). Don't hardcode "h:mm a".

**Translations.** All UI text is in `res/values/strings.xml` (composables: `stringResource`; with a Context: `getString`; otherwise `AppText.get`/`plural`), with `values-fr` (human-checked), `values-de`, `values-nl`, `values-es`, `values-he` (machine-translated from the server glossary). New text needs an entry in every one; `tools/i18n/check_strings.py` (pre-commit) checks names and format arguments, `tools/i18n/server_glossary.py <lang>` gives the server's terms. Anything sent to the server stays English (see CONTRIBUTING.md → Translations).

**Shared timers.** A running breastfeed or sleep is mirrored to a Baby Buddy timer (`api/timers/`) whose name carries the live state (`data/repository/SharedTimers.kt`, marker `#bb1`). Local actions bump `changedAtMillis` and signal a conflated channel that creates/renames/deletes the timer (`pushTimer`); `pollSharedTimers` (on refresh, every 15 s while the app is resumed, and from `widget/TimerSyncService.kt` while a feed or sleep runs with the app closed) adopts newer remote state, ends a timer removed elsewhere (`feedEndedElsewhere`/`sleepEndedElsewhere`, which also drop that feed's queued minute-saves), and links an adopted feed to its feeding record via `feedingServerId`. Newest `changedAtMillis` wins; `feedEndedAt`/`sleepEndedAt` stop an ended timer from being re-adopted. Only the phone that stops a sleep saves the sleep entry. A rename that gets 404 for our own timer means it ended elsewhere: end locally, never recreate it.

`TimerSyncService` is a foreground service (`specialUse`) that runs only while a feed or sleep is timed and the lock-screen timers are on; its notification is the feed (else sleep) notification, and it polls the shared timers every 15 s during a feed, 60 s during a sleep, so the app isn't frozen and a feed ended on another phone ends here too. `BabyBuddyApplication` starts/stops it.

**Reminders and Today extras.** `widget/Reminders.kt` schedules inexact alarms for "feed due" (`ReminderSettings.feedAfterMinutes` after `repository.lastFeedMillis`), "diaper change due" (`diaperAfterMinutes` after `lastDiaper`), "awake for" (after `lastSleepEndMillis`) and "asleep for" (after the running sleep timer's start); with `earlyMinutes` set, a heads-up ("due in 10m") is posted that long before, and the due notification replaces it; `ReminderReceiver` refreshes from the server before posting, and each fires once per anchor; `RescheduleReceiver` (boot, app update, clock/time-zone change; `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`) sets the alarms again. Permissions are only `INTERNET`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` (requested at start when lock-screen timers or any reminder is on, and when turning those on), `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED` and `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`/`FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE` (TimerSyncService); cleartext HTTP is allowed for LAN servers. `widget/SleepNotification.kt` is the lock-screen sleep timer (same toggle as the feed controls). Milk stash = latest note tagged `milk-stash` ("Milk stash: N ml", shared across phones) + pumping since − breast-milk bottles since (`repository.milkStash`). Quick notes on Today are one-tap notes for the server's tags (`api/tags/`). Baths have no server model: a bath is a note tagged `bath` (`BATH_TAG`; text "Bath" or the user's note) — logged from Today (quick action, "Last bath" tile), the Log screen or edited in History (`HistoryDay.baths`, `HistoryFilter.BATH`); `repository.lastBathMillis` = latest bath among today's notes and the last 45 days on the server. All other notes show in History too (`HistoryDay.notes`, `HistoryFilter.NOTES`, `EditNoteDialog`; `repository.updateNote`/`deleteNoteEvent` handle both and keep tags).

**Tiles, shortcuts, handoff, next-up.** `widget/QuickTiles.kt`: Quick Settings tiles (`FeedTileService` start/pause like the timer widget, on `repository.nextStartSide()`, `SleepTileService` start/stop, `DiaperTileService` opens the diaper log; signed out they open the app); `QuickTile.refreshAll` on timer/login changes (`BabyBuddyApplication`); long-press opens `MainActivity` with `ACTION_QS_TILE_PREFERENCES`, routed by tile in `handleWidgetNavigation`. `widget/AppShortcuts.kt`: dynamic launcher shortcuts (Feed left/right, Diaper, Sleep now; only signed in and for tracked items) carrying `EXTRA_SHORTCUT_ACTION`, done in `handleWidgetNavigation` (a feed shortcut never pauses that side). "While you were away" (`HandoffSummary`, `repository.handoff`, `HandoffCard` on Today): `MainActivity.onStop` → `markAway` (prefs `away_since`); after each refresh `checkHandoff` collects feeds/changes/sleeps since then (≤ 24 h; fetched from the server if before midnight) logged by someone else (caregiver ≠ this phone's name; with no name set, only named entries). `widget/NextUpNotification.kt`: silent lock-screen countdown to `repository.nextUpTimes` (model times, else the feed/diaper reminder intervals), Settings → Notifications (prefs `next_up_notification`, off by default), hidden while a feed runs or a sleep's notification is up.

**Breastfeed start side** (`StartSide`, Settings → You, prefs `start_side`, `repository.startSide`): opposite of the last feed (default), same, always left or always right; `nextStartSide()` is used by every one-tap start (timer widget, `WidgetActionReceiver`, Feed tile). In the app the user taps a side.

README is the short overview; the detailed feature guides (widgets, lock screen, tiles, reminders, rhythm models, While you were away) are in `docs/FEATURES.md`, build/test/pre-commit/project layout in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and the server field mapping (and phone-only settings) in `docs/ICD.md`. Screenshots there use `../fastlane/...` paths.

**Tracked items** (`TrackedItem`, Settings → Tracked items, prefs `hidden_items`, per phone): a hidden item is left out of Today (tiles, cards, quick actions), History (filters and entries via `HistoryDay.withoutHidden`), Trends and reminders. New UI for an item should check `hiddenItems`. Home-screen widgets don't follow it.
